dataset.description: Data collection contains lexical data for Livonian with meanings provided in Latvian, Estonian and English, as well morphology data and pronunciation examples. Data is collected as part of the State Research programme (Latvia) “Latvian Studies for the Development of a Latvian and European Society" project “Multifunctional dictionary of Livonian” (VPP-LETONIKA-2021/2-0002).
dataset.title: Linguistic data for Livonian

dmp.description: Data plan describes data management for data collected and created for Livonian within State Research programme (Latvia) “Latvian Studies for the Development of a Latvian and European Society" project “Multifunctional dictionary of Livonian” (VPP-LETONIKA-2021/2-0002). It contains lexical data for Livonian with meanings provided in Latvian, Estonian and English, as well morphology data and prununciation examples.
dmp.title: Linguistic data for Livonian
